info.name: Crumb & Co. — Backend API
info.description:
Complete Postman collection for the Crumb & Co. e-commerce backend (Express v5 + Prisma).

## Setup
1. Start the server: `npm run dev` (defaults to http://localhost:4000).
2. Seed the database: `npm run db:seed` (creates the admin `admin@crumbco.dev` / `Admin123!`, categories and products).
3. Import the environment `crumb-and-co.environment.json` and select it.

## How to run
- Run the whole collection in order (Auth → Me → Users → Categories → Products → Cart → Orders → Cleanup).
- Tokens are captured automatically: Login requests store the JWT in the environment variable `accessToken` / `adminAccessToken`, which every protected request reads.
- Refresh tokens are httpOnly cookies handled automatically by Postman's cookie jar.
- Re-running is mostly idempotent: create requests tolerate 409 (already exists). If an earlier create 409s, later requests reuse the seeded category/product captured from the list endpoints.

## Auth model
- Register/login → access JWT (Bearer). Refresh token delivered via httpOnly cookie on `/api/v1/auth`.
- Admin endpoints require the seeded admin (or any user promoted via PATCH /users/:id/role).
- Mock payment provider auto-marks orders PAID.

item.name: Users (Admin)
item.description: Admin-only user management.

item.name: Update User Role / Active
item.description: Demonstrates role + isActive management on the managed user.

item.name: Categories
item.description: Categories are public to read; creation is admin-only.

item.name: Products
item.description: Products are public to read; writes are admin-only.

item.name: Get Product by Slug
item.description: Uses a seeded product and captures its id for the cart/checkout flow.

item.name: Update Product
item.description: Updates the product created above (requires `createdProductId`).

item.name: Cart
item.description: Per-user cart. The last request re-adds an item so the cart-based checkout in the Orders folder has stock to buy.

item.name: Orders
item.description: Checkout (guest and cart-based), listing, single order, admin status updates. Mock payment auto-pays, so orders are created as PAID.

item.name: Checkout (guest)
item.description: Guest checkout sends explicit items. Saves the guest order id for the 403 negative test.

item.name: Checkout (cart)
item.description: Authenticated checkout without `items` uses the user's cart and clears it after.

item.name: Update Order Status
item.description: Admin moves the paid order from PAID → PROCESSING.

item.name: Cleanup
item.description: Deletes the product created during this run (soft delete).

item.name: Delete Product
item.description: Soft deletes `createdProductId` (sets isActive=false). Kept last so the cart/order flows still have stock.

item.name: Negative Tests
item.description: Failure scenarios covering every error code: 400 VALIDATION_ERROR, 400/NOT_FOUND, 401 UNAUTHORIZED, 403 FORBIDDEN, 404 NOT_FOUND, 409 CONFLICT, 409 INSUFFICIENT_STOCK, 429 RATE_LIMITED. Runs after the happy paths so it can reuse captured ids and tokens. The final rate-limit test temporarily locks /auth/login + /auth/refresh for ~1 minute.

item.name: List Users — customer token (403)
item.description: Customer token hitting an admin-only route.

item.name: Create Category — duplicate slug (409)
item.description: Re-creating the 'seasonal' slug already created in the happy path.

item.name: Add Cart Item — invalid product id (400)
Update Order Status — invalid transition (409)
item.description: Tries to move the paid order back to PENDING, which is not a valid transition from PAID or PROCESSING.

item.name: Refresh — without cookie (401)
item.description: Clears the cookie jar first so the refresh token cookie is gone → 'Missing refresh token'.

item.name: Get Guest Order as Customer (403)
item.description: A customer trying to view an order that belongs to no one (guest) or another user → forbidden.

item.name: Update Order Status as Customer (403)
item.description: A customer trying to update an order status (admin-only action).

item.name: Get Order — not found (404)
item.description: A valid UUID that does not exist.

item.name: Add Cart Item — product not found (404)
item.description: Valid UUID but the product does not exist.

item.name: Update Cart Item — not in cart (404)
item.description: The product is not in the customer's cart.

item.name: Remove Cart Item — not in cart (404)
Checkout — nonexistent product (400 / NOT_FOUND)
item.description: Checkout with a product that does not exist returns HTTP 400 with code NOT_FOUND.

item.name: Checkout — empty cart (409)
item.description: Authenticated checkout without items while the cart is empty → conflict. (Cart was cleared by the happy-path checkout.)

item.description: Tries to change the customer's email to another existing user's email (the managed user).
